text: The message is first moved by a route (23,930 of them: grids, rotations, the K3 rule with every start and step), then enciphered on the table with a repeating key. Under each route the known letters force key letters; where they sit side by side they form runs.
Each run was scored as English. The best, UHAVETHE, looks like words but is eight letters long out of 461,692 tries; short English-looking runs turn up by chance.
The best run on the copper beats the best on two shuffled coppers by a little, which is what a long search produces. Recorded as chance, not a lead.
